page_title: FIO 1-0 PIS | Fiorentina v Pisa 23/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Brilliant play from Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) to get past Nicolas Andrade in goal, but he fails to find the net from an acute angle.
90+3' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David de Gea intercepts the ball.
90+2' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+2' The whistle blows and Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) is booked for an infringement.
90+1' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but David de Gea comes off the line to clear the ball away.
88' Substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolo Fagioli walks off.
87' A corner kick by Fiorentina is thwarted by the well prepared Nicolas Andrade (Pisa).

87' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the top right corner, but Nicolas Andrade made a superb athletic save to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fiorentina.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Moise Kean as he is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).

85' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
83' Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Maurizio Mariani no option but to blow his whistle.
80' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
79' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) sees a yellow card from Maurizio Mariani after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
78' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' It will be a substitution. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is ready to enter the pitch as Dodo walks off.
78' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) replacing Manor Solomon.
77' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Fiorentina as they win a corner.
76' Stefano Moreo will be replaced by Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
74' Pisa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

73' That didn't go as planned! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Nicolas Andrade, who easily kept it out. The referee blows his whistle, Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
73' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Manor Solomon (Fiorentina), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
71' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
70' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Maurizio Mariani saw the whole situation.
67' A substitution has been made. Idrissa Toure goes off and Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) comes on.
65' The corner from Samuele Angori (Pisa) is cleared away by the defence.
65' A pass into the penalty area from Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is intercepted by the defence. Pisa win a corner.
62' A yellow card for a tackle by Marius Marin (Pisa). Maurizio Mariani doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
61' Some patient build-up play from Pisa as they look to unlock the defence.
58' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
58' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:2.
55' A dangerous towering header by Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
55' Pisa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
54' Henrik Meister (Pisa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes the mid-range free kick and sends it towards the roof of the net, but he is denied by the goalkeeper.
51' Marius Marin (Pisa) makes a strong challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Fiorentina have a free kick from a promising distance.
49' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
47' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Dodo (Fiorentina) gets booked.
46' Oscar Hiljemark makes a switch. Henrik Meister is coming on in place of Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa) at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Oscar Hiljemark gives a chance to Rafiu Durosinmi and Felipe Loyola (Pisa) is off.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Oscar Hiljemark probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa). He is replaced by Michel Aebischer.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Maurizio Mariani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
44' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
43' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
42' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
41' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' Flag up against Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
37' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) has received a yellow card for his foul.
34' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
34' The ball is cleared after Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
31' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
31' Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Some neat passing and movement from Fiorentina as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
26' The free kick from long range, taken by Fiorentina, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Dodo (Fiorentina) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.

24' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
24' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' The ball goes out for a corner. Pisa can continue in their attacking effort.
19' Maurizio Mariani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) and blew his whistle.
17' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Pisa was in an offside position.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:0.
12' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
11' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. It will be a corner kick for Fiorentina.
9' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nicolas Andrade, who smothers the ball.
8' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Nicolas Andrade has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
7' That was close by Moise Kean (Fiorentina)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
5' Fiorentina keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
3' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

The players are out at last! Pisa will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Maurizio Mariani.
